arguments.name: Showcase Review Rubric
arguments.description: Reminder that a showcase render is graded against media/showcase/v3/rubric.md by criterion id with cited evidence, never by impression.
arguments.subject: showcase-review
arguments.guidance: Grade only what was viewed. One mark per touched criterion: HOLDS, FAILS, UNPROVEN or TASTE, each with evidence at or above the criterion's minimum tier and the failing control it beats. Identity pigments unchanged (C1); role fills, no hex in assets (C2); designed, stippled shadows (C3, C4); black negative space, one emitter under the assets (C5, C6); frame interior refracted and drawn in depth (C7, C8); grain subordinate (C9); interior is the subject (C10); gadget familiar-impossible (C11); byte-identical renders (C12); no shimmer, drawn on twos, staggered, light lagging (C13, C16, C17, C18); acting reads without text (C14); palette travel never greys (C15). Receipt in five parts: Changed, Grades, Controls, Owner, Next.
